summary: On the US side, 2 Oct was dominated by a weak September payrolls print that still left long yields higher, after the 10-year touched its highest level since 2002 the day before. On the Turkish side, the week was dominated by the investment-fund liquidation crisis and its political fallout, which had already drained central bank reserves in mid-September.

items.title: September's jobs report misses: US added just 29,000 jobs, unemployment ticked up
items.why: Payrolls far below consensus, unemployment up to 4.2%, July–August revised down by 60k, wages +0.1% m/m.

items.title: Reaction roundup: Experts, analysts weigh in on September jobs report
items.why: October hike odds cut to about 22%, yet the 10-year rose about 3.4 bp to 5.27%, in line with the curve move in this report.

items.title: Markets News, Oct. 2, 2026: Indexes Rise Friday After Weak Jobs Report; Nasdaq Hits New High; Dow, S&P 500 Book Weekly Losses
items.why: 10-year dipped to about 5.16% on the data, then reversed to near 5.30%; G7 announced a 100m-barrel crude and diesel release.

items.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq stage comeback as Treasury yields fall, chip stocks gain
items.why: 10-year touched 5.34%, the highest since 2002; ISM prices paid jumped to 77.9; jobless claims fell to 197k.

items.title: Oil prices surge after Trump rejects Iran's plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz
items.why: Brent near $108 as Washington rejected a reopen-for-sanctions-relief offer; an inflation driver for US yields and an import-bill risk for Turkey.

items.title: Ruling party co-founder warns Turkey's fund scandal could cost Erdoğan elections
items.why: Bülent Arınç put disputed investor losses at up to ₺800bn (about $16bn) and called for prosecutions.

items.title: Turkey's main opposition urges Erdoğan to resign or call election over fund crisis
items.why: Opposition demanded an early election over the liquidation of 131 funds (about $18bn, 455k investors).

items.title: Turkey's main opposition walks out in protest as Erdoğan opens parliament
items.why: Opposition walkout over jailed opposition figures, including İstanbul Mayor İmamoğlu, as the new legislative year opened.

items.title: Turkey widens fund scandal probe, over 200 suspects investigated
items.why: Justice Minister announced warrants for 217 suspects and a review of 26 stocks suspected of manipulation.

items.title: Turkey's central bank reserves fall $4.3 billion amid fund turmoil
items.why: FX assets down 9.2% in the week to 18 Sep; reserves down from $188bn in late August, with extra lira liquidity to banks.
